title: Root AID Continuity Proof
description: Break-glass root-AID rotation continuity artifact. The compromised old root must emit a signed rot event sealing the new root inception SAID (delegation anchor in field a). Verifiers check the CESR signature against the old KEL copy held by witnesses/watchers/contacts. An optional new-root IXN back-reference to the prior KEL tail is supplementary only.

old_root_aid.description: Compromised/restored root AID that authorized the handoff

new_root_aid.description: Fresh root AID minted via KERI inception after break-glass recovery

new_inception_said.description: SAID of the new root inception event sealed in the old-root authorization rot

authorization_event.description: Old-root rot event with seal [{"d":"<new_inception_said>"}] in field a, signed by the pre-rotated key

authorization_cesr_signature.description: CESR Cigar signature over the authorization rot event raw bytes

authorization_event_said.description: SAID of the authorization rot event

back_anchor_event.description: Optional new-root IXN event sealing prior_kel_tail_said (bidirectional link only)

back_anchor_cesr_signature.description: CESR signature over the optional back-anchor IXN event

back_anchor_event_said.description: SAID of the optional back-anchor IXN event

prior_kel_tail_said.description: SAID of the last event on the old root KEL before authorization rot

carry_forward_aids.description: Pairwise/contact AIDs the user chose to preserve across rotation
